enriched_description: Low, heavy-set spaniel with a distinctive golden liver-colored coat that is abundant, flat, and slightly wavy. Coat is rich golden-liver throughout with heavy feathering on chest, legs, and belly. Body is long, low, and massive with a short neck and deep chest. Head is broad and heavy with a pronounced occiput and square muzzle. Ears are thick, lobular, and set at eye level, covered with wavy hair. Eyes are large, hazel, and set wide apart with a soft, melancholy expression. Tail is docked and carried level with moderate feathering. The breed's distinctive features include its short legs, massive build, and unique golden-liver coloration.

Large water spaniel with a heavy coat of dense, liver-colored curls covering the body. Coat features a distinctive topknot of long, loose curls on the head and a nearly hairless 'rat tail' that is thick at the base and tapers to a fine point. Body is sturdy and well-muscled with a deep chest and level topline. Head is long with a nearly Roman nose and strong jaws. Ears are long, set low, and covered with long, curly hair. Eyes are medium-sized, almond-shaped, and dark hazel with an alert, intelligent expression. The breed's signature features are the crisp liver-colored curls, prominent topknot, and distinctive bare tail.

Large, powerful livestock guardian dog with a dense, white double coat that is wavy to straight. Coat is medium to long in length with a coarse outer coat and fine, woolly undercoat. Body is athletic and well-muscled with a slightly arched loin and deep chest. Head is moderately broad with a slightly domed skull and wedge-shaped muzzle. Ears are V-shaped, pendant, and set moderately high. Tail is carried low with a slight upward curve at the tip. Eyes are dark brown, almond-shaped, and set at a slight angle with an alert, intelligent expression. The breed's imposing size, white coat, and protective demeanor are its most distinctive features.

Small, stocky black dog with a distinctive abundant double coat forming a ruff around the neck. Coat is straight, harsh-textured, and stands off from the body, with shorter hair on the face, ears, and legs. Body is compact, square-proportioned, and sturdy. Head is fox-like with a broad skull tapering to a pointed muzzle. Ears are small, triangular, erect, and set high. Tail is naturally short or docked, carried high. Eyes are dark brown, small, and oval with a mischievous, alert expression. The breed's signature features include its black coat, fox-like face, and characteristic 'monkey dog' expression.

Black-coated Belgian sheepdog with a distinctive long, abundant double coat. Coat is dense and straight with a shorter head and front-of-legs, longer on the body, and especially abundant around the neck forming a pronounced ruff. Heavily plumed tail is long and carried low. Body is elegant, well-muscled, and square-proportioned. Head is clean-cut with a flat skull and tapering muzzle. Ears are triangular, stiff, erect, and set high. Eyes are medium-sized, almond-shaped, and dark brown with an intelligent, alert expression. The breed's signature features are its solid black coat, abundant ruff, and heavily plumed tail.

Fawn-colored, short-haired Belgian sheepdog with a dense, straight double coat. Coat color is rich fawn to mahogany with distinctive black overlay and black mask on the face. Body is athletic, well-muscled, and square-proportioned with a level topline. Head is clean-cut with a flat skull and parallel lines of skull and muzzle. Ears are triangular, stiff, erect, and set high. Tail is medium-length, strong at the base, and carried low with a slight upward curve. Eyes are medium-sized, almond-shaped, and dark brown with an intelligent, alert expression. The breed's distinctive features include its fawn coat with black overlay, black mask, and athletic build.

Large French sheepdog with a long, wavy, slightly stiff coat in black, tawny, or gray. Coat is abundant, dry, and falls naturally with a distinctive beard, mustache, and eyebrows. Body is powerful and well-proportioned with a level topline and deep chest. Head is long with a broad skull and square muzzle. Ears are set high, cropped or natural, and covered with long hair. Tail is long, well-feathered, and carried low with a slight upward curve (j-hook). Eyes are large, oval, and dark with an intelligent, alert expression. The breed's signature features include its long, wavy coat, distinctive facial furnishings, and characteristic j-hook tail.

Medium-sized Australian sheepdog with a short, dense double coat in black, black-and-tan, red, red-and-tan, fawn, or cream. Coat is weather-resistant with a soft undercoat and harsh outer coat. Body is athletic, well-muscled, and slightly longer than tall with a level topline. Head is fox-like with a broad skull and tapering muzzle. Ears are pointed, erect, and set wide apart with a slight outward tilt. Tail is moderately long, straight, and carried low. Eyes are oval, dark brown, and alert with an intelligent, keen expression. The breed's distinctive features include its pointed ears, athletic build, and tireless working ability.

Large, powerful Hungarian livestock guardian with a distinctive shaggy, corded white coat. Coat forms long, dense cords that hang to the ground, resembling dreadlocks, providing protection from weather and predators. Body is massive, well-muscled, and slightly longer than tall. Head is broad with a moderate skull and strong muzzle. Ears are pendant, V-shaped, and set moderately high, hidden within the cords. Tail is carried low with a slight upward curve. Eyes are dark brown, medium-sized, and set at a slight angle with an alert expression. The breed's most distinctive feature is its unique corded coat, which is entirely white.

Large sheepdog with a profuse, shaggy double coat in bluish-grey and white. Coat is harsh-textured, not straight, and abundant throughout the body with a dense, waterproof undercoat. Body is compact, square-proportioned, and well-muscled with a distinctive roly-poly appearance. Head is large and square with a bear-like gait. Ears are small, pendant, and carried flat against the head. Tail is traditionally docked, giving the breed its 'bobtail' nickname. Eyes are dark or pearl (wall eyes), set under a shaggy brow. The breed's signature features include its shaggy coat, bear-like gait, and distinctive head shape.
